name: Hospitality
purpose: Design and engineering guidance for hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, guest houses, lodges and accommodation-led hospitality businesses.
productPrinciple: Rooms, location, amenities, availability, policies and booking confidence are the product. Atmosphere supports the decision but cannot replace practical stay information.
primaryJourneys: book or enquire through a verified channel
rejectConditions: design before research gate is ready
stock or generated rooms presented as the property
booking widget presented as real without integration
amenities or policies inferred from category
image-heavy home page that hides rooms/location/booking
cinematic motion that delays booking or room inspection
